BROKEN_AIRPLAY.label:
This player is known to have broken AirPlay support. Playback may fail or simply be silent. There is no workaround for this issue at the moment. 
If you already enforced AirPlay 2 on the player and it remains silent, this is one of the known broken models. Only remedy is to nag the manufacturer for a fix.

airplay_protocol.label: AirPlay protocol version to use for streaming
airplay_protocol.description:
AirPlay version 1 protocol uses RAOP.
AirPlay version 2 is an extension of RAOP.
Some newer devices do not fully support RAOP and will only work with AirPlay version 2, while older devices may only support RAOP.

In most cases the default automatic selection will work fine.

NOTE: AirPlay 2 currently does not support audio synchronization. Grouping/syncing with other players is only available when using AirPlay 1 (RAOP).

disabled_reasons.1: This device does not advertise AirPlay 1 (RAOP) support.
disabled_reasons.2: This device does not advertise AirPlay 2 support.

encryption.label: Enable encryption
encryption.description: Enable encrypted communication with the player, some (3rd party) players require this to be disabled.

alac_encode.label: Enable compression
alac_encode.description: Save some network bandwidth by sending the audio as (lossless) ALAC at the cost of a bit of CPU.

password.label: Device password
password.description: Some devices require a password to connect/play.

ignore_volume.label: Ignore volume reports sent by the device itself
ignore_volume.description:
The AirPlay protocol allows devices to report their own volume level. 
For some devices this is not reliable and can cause unexpected volume changes. 
Enable this option to ignore these reports.

airplay_latency.label: Milliseconds of data to buffer
airplay_latency.description:
The number of milliseconds of data to buffer
NOTE: This adds to the latency experienced for commencement of playback. 
Try increasing value if playback is unreliable.

session_establishment_latency.label: Expected milliseconds to establish streaming session with the AirPlay device.
session_establishment_latency.description:
Adjust this value only if playback is out of sync or does not work.
The log will contain a WARNING entry showing a recommendation.

AIRPLAY2_SYNC_WARN.label: Music Assistant support for the AirPlay2 protocol does support audio synchronisation, but it is fragile. If playback or synchronisation does not work, try adjusting the session establishment latency. This is an interim advanced configuration setting. It will be removed when a robust synchronisation method is implemented.

pairing_pin.label: Enter the 4-digit PIN shown on the device

pairing_instructions.label: This device requires {0} pairing before it can be used. Click the button below to start the pairing process.

pairing_status.label: Device is paired ({0}) and ready to use.
